claims.claim: If the last day for an act required by law within a specified period is a holiday, the period extends through the next day that is not a holiday.
claims.quote: If the last day for the performance of any act provided or required by law to be performed within a specified period of time is a holiday, then that period is hereby extended to and including the next day that is not a holiday.

claims.claim: For this purpose, all of Saturday is a holiday.
claims.quote: For purposes of this section, “holiday” means all day on Saturdays

claims.claim: The definition includes all holidays specified in Section 135.
The definition includes days Section 12b requires to be considered holidays, to the extent that section provides.
claims.quote: to the extent provided in Section 12b, all days that by terms of Section 12b are required to be considered as holidays.

claims.claim: A whole-day closure of a city, county, state or public office makes that day a holiday for computing time for that office’s business.
claims.quote: If any city, county, state, or public office, other than a branch office, is closed for the whole of any day, insofar as the business of that office is concerned, that day shall be considered as a holiday for the purposes of computing time under Sections 12 and 12a.
claims.note: The draft limits the rule to the business of the closed office.

claims.claim: The office-closure rule excludes branch offices.
Section 135 makes full days designated as holidays by Government Code Section 6700 judicial holidays, subject to listed exceptions.
claims.quote: Every full day designated as a holiday by Section 6700 of the Government Code, including that Thursday of November declared by the President to be Thanksgiving Day, is a judicial holiday, except the date corresponding with the second new moon following the winter solstice
claims.note: The draft acknowledges the exceptions without claiming to enumerate them.

claims.claim: Government Code Section 6700 lists every Sunday as a holiday.
claims.quote:
(a) The holidays in this state are:
(1) Every Sunday.

claims.claim: Every Saturday is a judicial holiday.
claims.quote: Every Saturday and the day after Thanksgiving Day are judicial holidays.

claims.claim: The day after Thanksgiving Day is a judicial holiday.
claims.quote: Every Saturday and the day after Thanksgiving Day are judicial holidays.

claims.claim: If a judicial holiday falls on Saturday or Sunday, the Judicial Council may designate an alternative observance day.
claims.quote: If a judicial holiday falls on a Saturday or a Sunday, the Judicial Council may designate an alternative day for observance of the holiday.

claims.claim: Section 12a applies to all provisions of law requiring an act on a particular day or within a specified period.
claims.quote: This section applies to Sections 659, 659a, and 921, and to all other provisions of law providing or requiring an act to be performed on a particular day or within a specified period of time, whether expressed in this or any other code or statute, ordinance, rule, or regulation.
